description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'SkillSearchFilterParams' used for filtering and sorting skill search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties for name and description filtering, along with sorting capabilities.

classes.name: SkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters and sorting options for skills.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the filter value for the skill's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the filter value for the skill's name.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the filter value for the skill's description.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the filter value for the skill's description.
